regional_vicariates.name: Regional Vicars
regional_vicariates.observation: The provinces are grouped under regional vicars who report to the prefects above them.

bound_estate_tenants.name: Bound Estate Tenants
bound_estate_tenants.observation: The law binds tenant farmers and their sons to the estates where they are registered for tax.
bound_estate_tenants.social_consequence: Tenants and their children may not leave the estate; the land is worked by men who cannot go

register_of_dignities.name: Register of Dignities
register_of_dignities.observation: One register lists every office of the realm, its rank, its insignia and the size of its staff.

ranked_priestly_hierarchy.name: The God's House Ranked
ranked_priestly_hierarchy.observation: The god's overseers of the towns answer to senior overseers in the great cities, and they to the heads of the oldest sees.
ranked_priestly_hierarchy.ability_reason: Town overseers of the god's house answer to senior overseers of the great cities; the god's house becomes a realm-wide ladder that holds when the ruler's officers fail.
ranked_priestly_hierarchy.social_consequence: The god's house keeps its own ranks and courts beside the ruler's

promulgated_edict_code.name: Official Edict Code
promulgated_edict_code.observation: Every standing edict is gathered into one official book and a copy sent to each court of the realm.
promulgated_edict_code.ability_reason: One official book of every standing edict goes to every court; judges across the realm cite the same text.

town_protector_office.name: Town Protector
town_protector_office.observation: A town protector is named to take the townsfolk's complaints against the tax officers to the governor.
town_protector_office.social_consequence: Townsfolk have an advocate against the tax officer

written_customary_codes.name: Written Customary Codes
written_customary_codes.observation: The newcomer kings have their peoples' customs of wergild and inheritance written down in the learned tongue.

priest_overseer_town_leadership.name: The God's Overseer Leads the Town
priest_overseer_town_leadership.observation: When the governor flees, the god's overseer feeds the town, mends the walls and ransoms its captives.
priest_overseer_town_leadership.social_consequence: When the officials fail, townsfolk turn to the god's overseer for bread, walls and ransom

personal_law_by_people.name: Each People Under Its Own Law
personal_law_by_people.observation: Each man is judged under the law of the people he was born to, and the court asks first which law he lives by.

jurist_digest_codification.name: Grand Digest
jurist_digest_codification.observation: A commission of jurists cuts centuries of learned opinions down to one digest and gives it the force of law.
jurist_digest_codification.ability_reason: Centuries of jurists' opinions are cut down to one digest with the force of law; the law can be learned from one book.

official_law_primer.name: Official Law Primer
official_law_primer.observation: An official primer sets out persons, things and actions for students beginning the law.

district_counts.name: District Counts
district_counts.observation: The ruler names a count to each district to lead its levy, collect its dues and hold its court.

household_great_offices.name: Household Great Offices
household_great_offices.observation: The steward, the marshal, the cupbearer and the chamberlain of the ruler's household run the realm as well as the hall.
household_great_offices.ability_reason: The ruler's own household officers run the realm; loyalty to the ruler's person replaces the old ministries.

ordeal_by_the_god.name: Trial by Ordeal
ordeal_by_the_god.observation: Where witnesses fail, the accused carries hot iron or is lowered into cold water, and the god's servants read the verdict.
ordeal_by_the_god.social_consequence: Guilt is judged by hot iron and cold water, and the god's servants read the sign

three_department_ministries.name: Three Departments, Six Ministries
three_department_ministries.observation: One department drafts, one reviews and one carries out, with six ministries for officials, revenue, rites, war, justice and works.
three_department_ministries.ability_reason: Drafting, reviewing and executing departments check one another, with six ministries beneath them; the realm is run by a standing bureaucracy.

equal_field_allotment.name: Equal Field Allotments
equal_field_allotment.observation: Officials reassign field allotments by the number of adults in each household, and take them back at death.

regular_merit_examinations.name: Regular Merit Examinations
regular_merit_examinations.observation: The palace holds examinations at fixed intervals, and candidates of any family may sit them.

military_frontier_provinces.name: Military Frontier Provinces
military_frontier_provinces.observation: Frontier provinces are put under one military governor who holds both the troops and the taxes.

witnessed_land_charters.name: Witnessed Land Charters
witnessed_land_charters.observation: Land is granted by a written charter that lists the bounds and ends with the names of the witnesses.

impeaching_censorate.name: Impeaching Censors
impeaching_censorate.observation: Censors may impeach any official, even a minister, and the ruler must hear the charge.

palace_mayor_regency.name: Palace Mayor
palace_mayor_regency.observation: The mayor of the palace commands the household and the warriors while the ruler only reigns.
palace_mayor_regency.social_consequence: The ruler reigns, but the mayor of the palace governs

homage_commendation.name: Homage
homage_commendation.observation: A free man kneels and puts his hands between his lord's, and becomes his man for protection and service.
homage_commendation.ability_reason: A free man commends himself to a lord for protection and service; loyalty is sworn person to person where the realm cannot reach.
homage_commendation.social_consequence: Every free man needs a lord, and the lord's word counts for more than the ruler's

hereditary_military_governors.name: Hereditary Military Governors
hereditary_military_governors.observation: The frontier governors pass their provinces, troops and taxes to their sons.
hereditary_military_governors.social_consequence: Provinces pass from father to son, and the ruler's writ stops at their borders

twice_yearly_coin_tax.name: Twice-yearly Coin Tax
twice_yearly_coin_tax.observation: Each household pays its tax in coin twice a year, in summer and in autumn, instead of in grain and cloth.

palace_school_for_officials.name: Palace School
palace_school_for_officials.observation: Nobles' sons are taught letters, law and service in the palace school before they are given office.

spring_magnate_assembly.name: Spring Assembly of Magnates
spring_magnate_assembly.observation: Each spring the magnates gather at the ruler's hall to hear his decrees and give their assent.

compulsory_tithe.name: Compulsory Tithe
compulsory_tithe.observation: A tenth of every harvest and every flock is owed by law to the god's house.
compulsory_tithe.social_consequence: A tenth of every harvest goes to the god's house, whatever the year

paired_royal_envoys.name: Paired Royal Envoys
paired_royal_envoys.observation: A layman and a servant of the god ride each circuit together, hearing complaints against the counts and judges.
paired_royal_envoys.ability_reason: Paired envoys ride set circuits, hear complaints and check the counts and judges; the ruler's eye reaches the districts again.

numbered_article_decrees.name: Numbered Decrees
numbered_article_decrees.observation: The ruler's decrees are issued in numbered articles, so each can be cited and obeyed on its own.

overlord_crowned_by_high_priest.name: Crowned by the God's High Servant
overlord_crowned_by_high_priest.observation: In the great house of the god, its head sets the crown on the overlord's head before the assembled lords.
overlord_crowned_by_high_priest.ability_reason: The head of the god's house crowns the overlord; rule over many peoples is sanctioned by the god himself, not only by the warband.
overlord_crowned_by_high_priest.social_consequence: The overlord's title now depends on the god's house that crowned him

seigneurial_immunity_courts.name: Immunity
seigneurial_immunity_courts.observation: The ruler's officers may not enter the lord's lands to judge or to collect, and the lord holds his own court.
seigneurial_immunity_courts.social_consequence: The ruler's officers may not cross the lord's bounds; the lord judges his own people

manor_court_customals.name: Manor Customals
manor_court_customals.observation: The manor court writes down each tenant's rents, labour days and dues, and the roll is read when there is dispute.

fief_tenure_for_service.name: Fiefs
fief_tenure_for_service.observation: A lord grants land to a sworn warrior, who holds it for as long as he comes armed and mounted when summoned.
fief_tenure_for_service.ability_reason: Land is granted to be held for sworn armed service; the realm pays its mounted warriors in land, and they come armed when their general summons them.
fief_tenure_for_service.social_consequence: Warriors hold the land, and the tillers owe them the harvest

hereditary_fief_succession.name: Hereditary Fiefs
hereditary_fief_succession.observation: By custom a fief passes to the holder's heir, who pays a relief and renews the oath.

frontier_march_lords.name: March Lords
frontier_march_lords.observation: Lords of the frontier marches may raise troops, build castles and make war without waiting for the ruler.

shire_reeve_courts.name: Shire Courts
shire_reeve_courts.observation: The free men of the shire meet twice a year in court with the ruler's reeve to settle land and wrongs.

prefect_guild_rulebook.name: Guild Rulebook
prefect_guild_rulebook.observation: The town governor's rulebook sets out each trade guild's members, prices, weights and duties.

itinerant_royal_court.name: Itinerant Court
itinerant_royal_court.observation: The ruler's household moves from estate to estate, eating each one's dues and holding court as it goes.
itinerant_royal_court.ability_reason: The court travels and lives on each estate's dues in turn; the ruler is seen in every part of the realm and stores need not be carted to him.
itinerant_royal_court.social_consequence: The ruler is near, but each estate must feed a hungry court when it arrives

smallholder_protection_laws.name: Smallholder Protection
smallholder_protection_laws.observation: Laws forbid the magnates to buy up small holdings, and restore those taken in hard years.

raider_tribute_land_tax.name: Raider Tribute Tax
raider_tribute_land_tax.observation: Every holding is assessed for a land tax, first raised to buy off the raiders and then kept.

castellan_local_lordship.name: Castle Lordship
castellan_local_lordship.observation: Each castle lord holds justice, tolls and the mill for the country his walls command.
castellan_local_lordship.social_consequence: Every castle lord takes his toll and his fine

sealed_royal_writs.name: Sealed Writs
sealed_royal_writs.observation: A short sealed order from the ruler tells a local court to do justice, or to explain why it has not.

holy_truce_days.name: The God's Peace
holy_truce_days.observation: The god's servants forbid fighting from the eve of the god's day to its end, and on the great feasts.
holy_truce_days.social_consequence: No lord may fight from the eve of the god's day to its end

anonymous_copied_exam_scripts.name: Anonymous Examination Scripts
anonymous_copied_exam_scripts.observation: Examination scripts are copied by clerks and graded under numbers, so no examiner knows whose hand he reads.

treasury_paper_notes.name: Treasury Paper Notes
treasury_paper_notes.observation: The treasury prints paper notes that pay taxes and pass in the markets like strings of coin.

mutual_surety_tithings.name: Surety Groups of Ten
mutual_surety_tithings.observation: Every man belongs to a group of ten who must bring him to court if he does wrong.

merchant_guild_monopoly.name: Merchant Guild Monopoly
merchant_guild_monopoly.observation: Only brothers of the merchant guild may buy and sell in the town market free of toll.
merchant_guild_monopoly.social_consequence: Only guild brothers may sell in the town market

closed_college_election.name: Closed College Election
closed_college_election.observation: The head of the god's house is chosen by a closed college of its senior servants, not by crowd or ruler.

royal_chancery_office.name: Chancery
royal_chancery_office.observation: Clerks under the keeper of the seal draft, seal and copy every grant and order in fixed forms.
royal_chancery_office.ability_reason: A writing office under the keeper of the seal drafts, seals and copies every grant and order; the ruler's will goes out in forms that every court recognises.

sworn_town_commune.name: Sworn Commune
sworn_town_commune.observation: The townsmen swear on the god's relics to aid one another against any lord who wrongs them.
sworn_town_commune.ability_reason: Townsmen swear mutual aid and govern themselves; the town becomes a body that can bargain, tax, wall itself and fight.
sworn_town_commune.social_consequence: The townsmen's oath binds them to each other before any lord

counting_table_audit.name: Counting-table Audit
counting_table_audit.observation: Twice a year the sheriffs account at a table chequered like a board, where counters show every sum owed and paid.
counting_table_audit.ability_reason: Sheriffs account twice a year at a chequered table where counters show every sum owed and paid; embezzlement becomes visible even to men who cannot read.

craft_guilds.observation: The masters of each craft set standards, prices and apprenticeships, and fine those who break them.

elected_town_consuls.name: Elected Consuls
elected_town_consuls.observation: The sworn commune elects consuls each year to lead it, judge its quarrels and speak for it.

great_hall_of_justice.name: Great Hall of Justice
great_hall_of_justice.observation: A great timber-roofed hall is built where the ruler's justice sits and the realm's courts meet.

priestly_investiture_settlement.name: Investiture Settlement
priestly_investiture_settlement.observation: The god's house invests its own overseers with ring and staff, and the ruler grants them the lands.

chief_justiciar_viceroy.name: Chief Justiciar
chief_justiciar_viceroy.observation: A chief justiciar governs, judges and collects in the ruler's name while he is abroad.

glossator_law_schools.name: Law Schools
glossator_law_schools.observation: Masters read the grand digest line by line and their students copy the glosses around the text.
glossator_law_schools.ability_reason: Law schools teach the grand digest with written glosses; trained jurists fill the courts and chanceries of every realm.

chartered_town_liberties.name: Chartered Town Liberties
chartered_town_liberties.observation: The town pays its lord for a charter of its own court, market and tolls, and its people become free burgesses.
chartered_town_liberties.ability_reason: Towns buy a charter of liberties from their lord; townsfolk hold their own court and market, and trade grows under a known law.
chartered_town_liberties.social_consequence: A year and a day in the chartered town makes a bond-servant free

annual_receipt_rolls.name: Annual Receipt Rolls
annual_receipt_rolls.observation: Each year's receipts and debts to the crown are written on skins sewn end to end and rolled.

public_notaries.name: Public Notaries
public_notaries.observation: Licensed notaries draw up contracts and wills whose copies prove themselves in any court.

sacred_law_concordance.name: Concordance of the God's Law
sacred_law_concordance.observation: A master harmonizes the conflicting laws of the god's house in one book, question by question.

fair_merchant_courts.name: Fair Courts
fair_merchant_courts.observation: At each fair a court of merchants judges disputes by merchant custom before the dust is off their feet.

royal_justice_circuits.name: Royal Justice Circuits
royal_justice_circuits.observation: Royal judges ride set circuits through every shire and try pleas under one common law.
royal_justice_circuits.ability_reason: Royal judges ride circuits through every shire under one common law; justice stops depending on the lord of the place.

presenting_jury_of_neighbours.name: Presenting Jury
presenting_jury_of_neighbours.observation: Twelve sworn men of each hundred tell the royal judges which of their neighbours are suspected of crimes.

hired_outside_magistrate.name: Outside Magistrate
hired_outside_magistrate.observation: The town hires a magistrate from another town for one year, so that he owes nothing to any local family.

writ_forms_of_action.name: Forms of Action
writ_forms_of_action.observation: Each kind of claim has its fixed writ, and a suit brought on the wrong writ fails.

salaried_royal_bailiffs.name: Salaried Bailiffs
salaried_royal_bailiffs.observation: Bailiffs paid a salary by the crown, not a share of the fines, keep order and collect in each district.

estates_assembly.name: Estates Summoned
estates_assembly.observation: The ruler summons the lords, the god's servants and delegates of the towns to grant aid and hear his needs.
estates_assembly.ability_reason: Lords, the god's servants and town delegates are summoned to grant aid; taxes need consent, and the realm speaks with one voice.
estates_assembly.social_consequence: The ruler must ask before he can take

chancery_enrolment_rolls.name: Chancery Enrolment Rolls
chancery_enrolment_rolls.observation: The chancery copies every letter it sends onto rolls, year by year, so any grant can be checked.

fixed_capital_archives.name: The Court Stops Travelling
fixed_capital_archives.observation: The treasury, the archives and the courts settle in one capital, and the ruler rides out while they stay.
fixed_capital_archives.ability_reason: Archives, treasury and courts settle in one capital; records can be found, suitors know where to go, and government continues while the ruler is away.

ordeal_abolition.name: Ordeals Abolished
ordeal_abolition.observation: The god's servants are forbidden to bless the ordeal, and courts must prove guilt by witnesses and jurors.

great_liberties_charter.name: Great Charter
great_liberties_charter.observation: The ruler seals a charter that no free man shall be seized or ruined except by judgment of his peers.
great_liberties_charter.ability_reason: The ruler seals a charter binding himself to the realm's liberties; no free man may be seized or ruined except by lawful judgment.
great_liberties_charter.social_consequence: The great lords can hold the ruler to his own seal

great_priestly_council_decrees.name: Great Council Decrees
great_priestly_council_decrees.observation: A great council of the god's house decrees rules for marriage, confession and its servants in every realm.

petty_trial_jury.name: Trial Jury
petty_trial_jury.observation: Twelve sworn neighbours hear the evidence and decide whether the accused is guilty.

inquisitorial_written_procedure.name: Written Inquest
inquisitorial_written_procedure.observation: The judge questions witnesses in private, writes their words into a dossier and decides from the file.
inquisitorial_written_procedure.social_consequence: Suspects are questioned in secret, and the dossier decides

revised_town_statute_books.name: Revised Town Statutes
revised_town_statute_books.observation: The town's statutes are revised, written in one book and sworn again by the council each year.

permanent_high_court.name: Permanent High Court
permanent_high_court.observation: The supreme court sits all year in the capital with its own judges and rolls, and every appeal ends there.
permanent_high_court.ability_reason: The supreme court sits permanently in the capital; its judgments bind lower courts and appeals have a place to go.

sworn_royal_council.name: Sworn Royal Council
sworn_royal_council.observation: Salaried councillors swear to advise the ruler truly and to keep the council's secrets.
sworn_royal_council.ability_reason: Salaried councillors swear to advise the ruler and meet regularly; policy is worked out in council, not only among the favourites of the moment.

funded_public_debt_shares.name: Funded Public Debt
funded_public_debt_shares.observation: The town's debts are pooled into one fund whose shares pay a fixed yearly interest and can be sold.

revised_realm_law_code.name: Realm Code in the Common Tongue
revised_realm_law_code.observation: The realm's law is revised and written in the everyday tongue, so lords and townsfolk can read it.
revised_realm_law_code.ability_reason: The realm's law is revised and written in the everyday tongue; judges, lords and townsfolk can read the law they are judged by.

chartered_town_league.name: League of Chartered Towns
chartered_town_league.observation: Chartered towns league together to protect their merchants, share their law and raise ships and men.

branch_banking_houses.name: Branch Banking Houses
branch_banking_houses.observation: A banking house keeps partners in many realms and moves money between them by letter.

consented_taxation.name: Taxation by Consent
consented_taxation.observation: No new tax may be raised until the estates have heard the need and granted it.

closed_hereditary_council.name: Closed Hereditary Council
closed_hereditary_council.observation: Only men of the families written in the register may sit on the great council.
closed_hereditary_council.social_consequence: Only the registered families may sit, and new men are shut out

privy_seal_office.name: Privy Seal Office
privy_seal_office.observation: A separate office keeps the ruler's small seal for his own orders, apart from the chancery.

coronation_oath_to_realm.name: Coronation Oath
coronation_oath_to_realm.observation: At his crowning the ruler swears to keep the laws and customs the realm has chosen.

fixed_court_of_accounts.name: Court of Accounts
fixed_court_of_accounts.observation: A court of accounts sits in the capital all year to audit every royal officer's books.

rank_sumptuary_laws.name: Sumptuary Laws
rank_sumptuary_laws.observation: Laws set out which furs, cloths and dishes each rank may use.
rank_sumptuary_laws.social_consequence: A merchant's wife may not wear what a lord's wife wears

double_entry_ledgers.name: Double-entry Ledgers
double_entry_ledgers.observation: Every sum is written twice, once as a debit and once as a credit, and the two sides must balance.

scrutiny_lot_elections.name: Scrutiny and Lot
scrutiny_lot_elections.observation: Names approved by scrutiny go into bags, and the town's offices are filled by drawing lots.

keepers_of_the_peace.name: Keepers of the Peace
keepers_of_the_peace.observation: Local gentlemen named keepers of the peace arrest and try lesser offenders in each shire.

elector_college_charter.name: Electors' Charter
elector_college_charter.observation: A sealed charter names the electors who choose the overlord and fixes where and how they vote.
elector_college_charter.ability_reason: A sealed charter fixes the electors of the overlord and the rules of the vote; succession stops being settled by war.
